column1: # JOSE JULIO LERENA'S BIRTH REGISTRATION - Montevideo, 5th section, certificate No. 283 of 1908.
# Registrar: Atilio C. Brignole, Juez de Paz. Index ark 1:1:6PNY-VLVD; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-W97S-F.
# IMAGE READ 13 September 2026, DeepZoom level 13. Declared by the child's own mother, at 64.
# A LATE registration: he was born in 1879 and registered in 1908, at twenty-nine - which is what a
# man does when he needs proof of birth to marry, and he does appear on a Montevideo marriage index

column2: *** 15 March 1879, at the house calle YI No. 303, Montevideo *** - "el dia quince del mes de Marzo del ano mil ochocientos setenta y nueve"
column3: The sixth child, and a second Montevideo address for the family.

column2: *** DONA JULIA JUANICO HERSELF *** - "de sesenta y cuatro anos de edad, de estado VIUDA, de nacionalidad oriental, de profesion labores, y vecina de la calle Buenos Aires No. 102"
column3: His mother, a widow of 64, living at calle Buenos Aires 102 in 1908. Two years before her death she walked into the Juzgado de Paz and registered her son's birth herself.

column2: hijo legitimo de la declarante y de su esposo Don LUIS LERENA LENGUAS, *** fallecido en esta Ciudad el veinte y cuatro de Diciembre de mil novecientos uno ***
column3: *** INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF THE DEATH FOUND THE SAME DAY. *** A completely different document, written seven years later by his widow, gives the identical date - 24 December 1901. The death act was found under the misspelling SERENA; this one was found under LERENA. They agree exactly.

column2: nieto por linea paterna de LUIS LERENA y JUSTINIANA LENGUAS - the first deceased; and *** "de ochenta y siete anos, oriental, viuda, labores, RESIDENTE EN LA REPUBLICA ARGENTINA la segunda" ***
column3: *** JUSTINIANA LENGUAS WAS ALIVE AT EIGHTY-SEVEN IN 1908, AND LIVING IN ARGENTINA. *** She was 79 and in Montevideo at her son's death in 1901. By 1908 the matriarch of this family had crossed the river. Her son GILBERTO moved to Buenos Aires between 1887 and 1889.

column2: y por linea materna de CANDIDO JUANICO y JULIANA GONZALEZ, fallecidos
column3: A sixth record naming Julia's parents, and both dead by 1908.

column2: se le ha puesto el nombre de JOSE JULIO
